description: Defines the NetworkChangeNotifier class and related enums and interfaces for monitoring system network changes, observers, and network interface details within the Chromium project.

classes.name: NetworkChangeNotifier
classes.description: Monitors system network changes and notifies registered observers; provides network interface info and connection type details.

classes.name: NetworkChangeObserver
classes.description: Interface for objects that want to be notified of network changes.

classes.name: MaxBandwidthObserver
classes.description: Interface for observing changes in network maximum bandwidth.

classes.name: ConnectionCostObserver
classes.description: Interface for observing changes in network connection cost.

classes.name: IPAddressObserver
classes.description: Deprecated interface for IP address change notifications.

classes.name: ConnectionTypeObserver
classes.description: Deprecated interface for connection type change notifications.

classes.name: DNSObserver
classes.description: Interface for DNS configuration change notifications.

classes.name: NetworkObserver
classes.description: Interface for observing network connection events on Android.

classes.name: DefaultNetworkActiveObserver
classes.description: Interface for observing when the default network enters high power state on Android.

classes.name: NetworkChangeCalculatorParams
classes.description: Struct for delay parameters used in network change signal calculation.

methods.name: GetFactory
methods.description: Returns the factory for creating platform-specific NetworkChangeNotifier instances.

methods.name: SetFactory
methods.description: Sets the factory for creating platform-specific NetworkChangeNotifier instances.

methods.name: CreateIfNeeded
methods.description: Creates the process-wide NetworkChangeNotifier if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: GetConnectionCost
methods.description: Returns the most likely cost attribute for the default network connection.

methods.name: GetConnectionType
methods.description: Returns the current connection type.

methods.name: GetConnectionSubtype
methods.description: Returns the current connection subtype.

methods.name: GetMaxBandwidthAndConnectionType
methods.description: Sets output parameters to the max bandwidth and connection type.

methods.name: GetMaxBandwidthMbpsForConnectionSubtype
methods.description: Returns max bandwidth in Mbps for a given connection subtype.

methods.name: AreNetworkHandlesSupported
methods.description: Checks if platform supports network handles APIs.

methods.name: GetConnectedNetworks
methods.description: Retrieves list of currently connected networks (Android only).

methods.name: GetNetworkConnectionType
methods.description: Returns connection type for a specific network handle (Android only).

methods.name: GetDefaultNetwork
methods.description: Returns the default network handle (Android only).

methods.name: GetSystemDnsConfigNotifier
methods.description: Returns the system DNS config change notifier.

methods.name: IsDefaultNetworkActive
methods.description: Checks if the default network is in high power state (Android only).

methods.name: IsOffline
methods.description: Determines if the device is offline.

methods.name: IsConnectionCellular
methods.description: Checks if a connection type is cellular.

methods.name: ConnectionTypeFromInterfaceList
methods.description: Infers connection type from a list of network interfaces.

methods.name: AddNetworkChangeObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer for network change events.

methods.name: RemoveNetworkChangeObserver
methods.description: Unregisters an observer for network change events.

methods.name: TriggerNonSystemDnsChange
methods.description: Signals a non-system DNS config change.

methods.name: NotifyObserversOfIPAddressChangeForTests
methods.description: Triggers IP address change notification for testing.

methods.name: NotifyObserversOfConnectionTypeChangeForTests
methods.description: Triggers connection type change notification for testing.

methods.name: NotifyObserversOfDNSChangeForTests
methods.description: Triggers DNS change notification for testing.

methods.name: NotifyObserversOfNetworkChangeForTests
methods.description: Triggers network change notification for testing.

methods.name: NotifyObserversOfMaxBandwidthChangeForTests
methods.description: Triggers max bandwidth change notification for testing.

methods.name: NotifyObserversOfConnectionCostChangeForTests
methods.description: Triggers connection cost change notification for testing.

methods.name: NotifyObserversOfDefaultNetworkActiveForTests
methods.description: Triggers default network active notification for testing.

methods.name: SetTestNotificationsOnly
methods.description: Enables or disables test-only notifications.

methods.name: ConnectionTypeToString
methods.description: Converts connection type enum to string.

methods.name: DisableForTest
methods.description: Helper class to disable real notifications for testing.
